title: Organize courses into modules
summary: Combine unenrolled courses into a draft course while preserving lesson content and privacy.

changes.text: Drag a course onto another draft course to move it as a module, with confirmation before moving.
Use Move into another course from course actions to choose a destination without dragging.
Courses with enrollment history cannot be moved. Source courses are archived after a successful move.

title: Assessment uploads and safer content management
summary: Collect video and document answers and protect learner history when managing content.

changes.text: Add video upload and file upload questions to assessments.
Review document answers alongside written assessment answers and retain existing video review screens.
Permanently delete unused courses and content; courses with learner enrollment history must be archived.
Archived courses are unavailable to learners, including enrolled learners.

title: More lesson formats
summary: Teach with documents and audio alongside video, with clear upload limits.

changes.text: Add PDF, Word, and PowerPoint lesson files with private in-app previews.
Add audio lessons hosted in Bunny, with a 30-minute limit.
Video lessons are limited to 15 minutes, with a duration check before upload.

title: More control over course access
summary: Manage private learning content and learner access, with fewer interruptions to your work.

changes.text: Mark courses and lessons private from course access settings.
Enroll learners into private courses and grant individual access to private lessons inside public courses.
Staff sessions renew in the background while you use the workspace.
Browse versioned release notes and revisit the full update history from What’s new.
